messages.subject: [FLR-list] plot FLStocks?
messages.body_plain:
Hi, sitting at STECF, I wonder how to easily superpose two FLStocks objects on a plot - typically, the same stock with multiple iterations, projected under two management scenario, and where we want to compare trajectories of catch and SSB. 

In lattice I think that this used to work

Plot(FLStocks(x1,x2)) but this does not work anymore, and breaks if ggplotFL is activated.

Any quick hint welcome, even if it is a dirty one ;-)

Thanks in advance

Clara

messages.subject: [FLR-list] plot FLStocks?
messages.body_plain:
Remember to give names to the objects,

plot(FLStocks(A=ple4, B=ple4))

and it should work. Same with ggplotFL


Iago

messages.subject: [FLR-list] disc.nyears in stf()
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I have added the disc.nyears argument to stf, which defaults to the same 
value as wts.nyears, so old code should still work.

Package not compiled yet, so please test using

library(devtools)

install_github('flr/FLAssess')

for which you will need Rtools installed.

Package will bve updated in repository over the next few days

Cheers,


Iago

On 16/06/15 23:59, Clara Ulrich wrote:
> Hi,
>
> I just found out that there used to be an argument disc.nyrs in stf() allowing to choose the number of years to be used for calculating the proportions of landings.n vs. discards.n - at least, the help file still mention it. But the current function does not have that one anymore, it uses wts.nyears - so it is for example not possible to use a three years average for weight at age and a one year average for the discards ratio... which North Sea cod forecast uses...
>
> Would it be possible to re-introduce that argument? I see no reason why this should not be there anymore?
>
> Thanks
> Clara
